The published V2 response normalized 228 providers and 9,313 entries with public-schema round trips in isolated storage. V2 remains opt-in through configured sources; see evaluations/model-catalog-2026-10-23-validation.json.

151 Core regressions, 7 focused runner tests, 13 Schema tests and 5 Client tests passed; canonical lint/typecheck and generated SDK stability recorded in evaluations/conditional-pricing-2026-10-23-validation.json. Archived V2 prices replayed with synthetic meters. Conditional quotes, explicit meters, durable cost assessment and derived budget/statistics coverage preserve historical amounts. No live billing or publication.

24 CLI and 66 Client tests passed; canonical lint/typecheck passed all 27 tasks. Real CLI subprocesses consumed local fixture HTTP responses in text and JSON, and the live-projection negative control detected all three missing assessments. See evaluations/cost-display-2026-10-23-validation.json; session-family indicators are tracked separately.

178 focused tests and 3 production-build browser tests passed; canonical lint/typecheck passed all 27 tasks. TUI rendering covers 44 and 120 columns; ACP is exercised over its wire protocol. Zero-valued unloaded-child refresh has a failing negative control. A limited three-sample browser entry comparison is recorded alongside results in evaluations/family-cost-2026-10-23-validation.json.
